# --- Fact Sheet ---
FactSheet: https://www.getinsightscoop.com/facts

# --- Core Q&A ---

Q: What services does InsightScoop offer?
A: InsightScoop offers weekly and bi-weekly dog waste removal, one-time cleanups, yard deodorizing, and AI-powered stool health insights using the 3 C's analysis.

Q: What cities does InsightScoop serve?
A: InsightScoop serves the Twin Cities metro: Minneapolis, St. Paul, Richfield, Edina, Bloomington, and surrounding suburbs. Expanding to new markets in Spring 2026.

Q: Is InsightScoop eco-friendly?
A: Yes, InsightScoop uses responsible disposal methods to reduce environmental impact and protect local waterways from contamination.

Q: Does InsightScoop offer health insights?
A: Yes, InsightScoop offers AI-powered, non-diagnostic stool monitoring using the 3 C's (Color, Consistency, Content) to help owners notice health changes early.

Q: Is InsightScoop licensed and insured?
A: Yes, InsightScoop is fully licensed and insured for all services.

Q: What is InsightScoop's pricing?
A: Weekly service starts at $20/visit, bi-weekly at $19/visit. Pricing depends on yard size and number of dogs.

Q: How does InsightScoop's AI analysis work?
A: Our 3 C's analysis tracks Color, Consistency, and Content changes in your dog's waste to identify potential health issues early. You receive wellness insights via the app.

Q: How do I become an InsightScoop scooper?
A: Apply at getinsightscoop.com/field-tech/apply. Set your own hours, earn $20-35/hour, no experience needed. Background check required.

# --- Definitions ---

Definition: 3 C's Analysis
Explanation: InsightScoop's AI-powered stool analysis tracking Color, Consistency, and Content changes to identify potential health issues early.

Definition: Melena
Explanation: Black, tarry stools, often indicating digested blood from the upper gastrointestinal tract. Requires timely veterinary evaluation.

Definition: Hematochezia
Explanation: Bright red blood in stool, typically indicating bleeding in the lower gastrointestinal tract or colon. Warrants veterinary guidance.

Definition: Service Tile
Explanation: InsightScoop's geographic coverage area unit. Each tile represents a service zone where scoopers are assigned routes.
